description: Split a PDF into multiple files by page range client and server side from freedailypro, or combine specific ranges into one reordered file

combineIntoOne.description: If true, combines all specified ranges into a single reordered PDF instead of one file per group

ranges.description: Semicolon-separated groups, each a comma-separated list of pages/ranges, e.g. '1-3,5;7-9' for two output files

name: pdf_split
